content.title: Fifth Child on the Way for Jude Law
content.text: "Whilst they are no longer in a relationship, they are both wholeheartedly committed to raising their child," the actor's rep says in a statement. David Fisher/Rex Jude Law is going to be a dad again! The Dom Hemingway star and his ex are set to welcome a baby together, his rep confirms to PEOPLE exclusively. “I can confirm that Jude Law and Catherine Harding are expecting a child together in the spring. Whilst they are no longer in a relationship, they are both wholeheartedly committed to raising their child,” the actor’s rep says in a statement. “They consider this a private matter and other than this confirmation no statement will be made. I ask that you respect the privacy of all parties involved and their families.” According to British media reports, Harding is a 23-year-old singer-songwriter who also goes by the name Cat Cavelli. The two reportedly spent time together earlier this summer while the actor was shooting on location in the Czech Republic. Law, 41, has three children with ex-wife Sadie Frost (sons Rafferty, 18, and Rudy, 12, and daughter Iris, who turns 14 this month) and another daughter, Sophia, 5, with model Samantha Burke. “Being a daddy is what counts,” he told PARADE in 2009. “I used to sleep until noon, but it’s not so bad to have to get up at 7 and give them breakfast. My daughter made me realize that if there’s anything that’s going to make a man of you, it’s having your will broken by a little girl.” — Michele Corriston with reporting by Julie Jordan
